title: PSQ Holdings Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Revenue Growth of 108% GAAP Operating Loss Improves to $4.8 Million Positive Non-GAAP Operating Income of $0.4 Million Revenue Per Headcount Improves 316% PSQ Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: PSQH) (the “Company”), a payments and financial infrastructure company, today reported financial results for the second quarter 2026. SECOND QUARTER 2026 HIGHLIGHTS Net revenue from continuing operations, which includes the financial technology (“fintech”) segment, for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 was $7.1 million compared to $3.4 million for the second quarter ended June 30, 2025, a 108% increase compared to the prior year period. Operating expense (defined as general and administrative, sales and marketing, and research and development expense) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 increased $1.0 million or an increase of 16% compared to the prior year period.
